name: It's A Beautiful World
source:
It's A Beautiful World is a short visual novel that takes place in a post apocalyptic world where the world that we know today is no longer the same and androids have ruled over. The story follows the character Leon, a man in his late 40's. A lone survivor who roams around this empty world trying to forget his dark past. Everything changes when Leon comes across a girl who is an android, alone in an empty run down museum. You then follow the story of them wandering around this empty yet beautiful world.

[From [url=http://dark06star.itch.io/its-a-beautiful-world]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《美丽的世界》是一部短篇视觉小说，故事发生在一个后世界末日的世界，我们今天所知道的世界已不再一样，机器人已经统治了世界。故事围绕角色莱昂展开，他是一位40多岁的男人。一个孤独的幸存者，在这个空虚的世界中徘徊，试图忘记自己黑暗的过去。当莱昂遇到一个机器人女孩独自在一座空荡荡的破旧博物馆时，一切都发生了变化。然后你将跟随他们在这个空虚而美丽的世界中徘徊的故事。

[来自[url=http://dark06star.itch.io/its-a-beautiful-world]itch.io[/url]]
